title: Scrouting: Cost-Aware Routing of Coding Agents by Scouting the Repository First
abstract: arXiv:2608.04804v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Frontier language models can resolve repository-level software issues, but each attempt is expensive, and existing routers select a model from the issue text alone. We present SuperScout, which routes after scouting the repository: a 7B searcher, SuperScout-7B, first explores the repository and produces a structured handoff whose reproduction claims are sandbox-verified, with false claims stripped before delivery. The searcher's hidden states, together with the task text, then feed a resume-based router that dispatches the task to one of four frontier fixers. Adding a new fixer requires no retraining. On the full Python slice of SWE-bench Pro (266 tasks) under the benchmark's official capped budget tier, SuperScout matches the best single model's solve rate (159 of 266 for SuperScout, 158 for the best model) at about a fifth of the total cost per solve, and the reported configuration sits above the random traffic-splitting base

translated_title: Scrouting：通过先侦察仓库实现成本感知的编码智能体路由
translated_abstract: 前沿语言模型能够解决仓库级别的软件问题，但每次尝试成本高昂，且现有的路由器仅根据问题文本来选择模型。我们提出了SuperScout，它在侦察仓库之后再进行路由：一个7B的搜索器SuperScout-7B首先探索仓库并生成结构化的交接文档，其中的复现声明经过沙箱验证，虚假声明在交付前会被剔除。随后，搜索器的隐藏状态与任务文本一起输入一个基于该交接文档（resume）的路由器，由其将任务分派给四个前沿修复模型之一。添加新的修复模型无需重新训练。在SWE-bench Pro的完整Python切片（266个任务）上，在基准测试官方设定的预算上限级别下，SuperScout以每次求解约五分之一总成本的代价，达到了与最佳单一模型相当的解决率（SuperScout为266个任务中的159个，最佳模型为158个），且所报告的配置优于随机流量分配基线。
tldr: SuperScout先用一个7B搜索器侦察仓库并生成经沙箱验证的结构化交接文档，再据此将编码任务路由至合适的前沿模型，在SWE-bench Pro上以约五分之一的成本达到与最佳单一模型相当的解决率，且新增修复模型无需重新训练。
en_tdlr: SuperScout routes coding tasks by first scouting the repository with a 7B searcher that produces sandbox-verified structured handoffs, matching the best single model's solve rate on SWE-bench Pro at about one-fifth of the cost, while adding a new fixer requires no retraining.
